owner.description: Owner identifier to look up by; accepts nameservice names (e.g. "alice.dys") or bech32 addresses. Resolution is performed server-side prior to querying the store.

index.description: Index of the storage entry to retrieve.

extract.description: Optional GJSON path to extract from the storage entry (e.g., "user.name"); max 100 characters.

dysonprotocol.storage.v1.QueryStorageGet.title: Query Storage Get Request
dysonprotocol.storage.v1.QueryStorageGet.description: QueryStorageGetRequest retrieves a single storage entry with optional field extraction. Owner resolution supports both nameservice names and bech32 addresses. Extract parameter enables GJSON path-based field retrieval from stored JSON data.

entry.description: The storage entry matching the query; data field contains extracted data if extract path was provided.

dysonprotocol.storage.v1.QueryStorageGet.title: Query Storage Get Response
dysonprotocol.storage.v1.QueryStorageGet.description: Response containing the retrieved storage entry.

owner.description: owner is the account address that owns this storage entry.

index.description: index is the key/index for the storage entry (within the owner's namespace).

data.description: data is the stored string value associated with the index.

updated_height.description: updated_height is block height of last modification.

updated_timestamp.description: updated_timestamp is the block time in UTC (RFC3339 e.g. "2025-06-11T15:23:00Z") when entry was modified.

hash.description: hash is SHA-256 hex of data field.
